spot_panchnama.place: Flat 302, Third Floor, Rishi Apartments, Ajmal Khan Road, Karol Bagh, New Delhi

location_details.entry_door: Main door with single-leaf wooden frame and Godrej padlock (broken)
location_details.exit_route: Same main door, staircase, main gate

flat_layout_observed.ransacking_observation: Living room sofa cushions displaced, kitchen cabinet drawers open, master bedroom wardrobe doors open, almirah broken open

evidence_at_scene.description: 20-inch long iron rod, likely used to break the almirah
Latent prints lifted on gelatin sheet
Single right foot impression (size 9, chevron sole pattern)
Leverage marks consistent with iron rod
Pry marks matching iron rod tip
Black fibre particles - likely from bag or clothing

photographs_taken.photographer: HC Ramesh Kumar, Photography Section, PS Karol Bagh
photograph_details: Frame 001-006: Exterior view of Rishi Apartments, main gate, staircase
Frame 007-010: Main door with broken padlock (wide and close-up)
Frame 016-020: Master bedroom with broken almirah
Frame 021-025: Close-up of broken almirah lock and door
Frame 026-028: Iron rod with measurement scale
Frame 029-031: Bedroom and kitchen showing ransacking
Frame 032-035: Overall view of flat layout

apartment_main_gate_camera.coverage: Main entrance gate, lobby, staircase entrance
key_observations: 14:20:15 - Male in black t-shirt enters gate, faces camera briefly
14:52:40 - Same male exits with black bag, walks quickly towards road

street_camera.coverage: Ajmal Khan Road street (managed by MCD)
street_camera.observations: Black Hero Splendor DL4SBK7890 parked 30m from building between 14:15-14:55

measurements_reference_points.reference_1_building_main_gate: Fixed reference point at main gate

spot_panchnama.panchnama_conclusion: The scene reveals forced entry through main door, targeted theft focused on master bedroom almirah. Physical evidence indicates single perpetrator using iron rod. Time window of crime 14:30-14:52. CCTV footage corroborates entry and exit times of suspect matching the accused's description.
